name: E-commerce AI Agent - Weekly Reviews (Amazon & Daraz)

parameters.inputText:
=You are a sentiment classifier.  
Classify the following product review as **Positive**, **Neutral**, or **Negative**.  
Also assign a sentiment score between -1 and 1 (-1 = very negative, 0 = neutral, +1 = very positive).  

Return the result ONLY as strict JSON (no explanation, no extra text):  
{"label": "Positive|Neutral|Negative", "score": <number between -1 and 1>}  

Review text:  
{{$json.text}}
